reviews.text: I have never had anything but a wonderful experience each time I visit the spa! The massage was fantastic and the atmosphere is so calming and relaxing. I love this place!
Lovely center. Staff was very warm and accommodating. Gloria was great with deep tissue massage. Erica was wonderful with the facial. Will definitely go again!

Had a facial with Erica. She did an amazing job. I highly recommend her. The spa is the best kept secret in Lubbock. So, calm and relaxing! Loved the whole experience! I used a special they were running!
